subject: Adding models- how to set up commons folder

messages.author: 02f8d235da5e0284
messages.subject: Adding models- how to set up commons folder
parts:
Hi team,

Im trying to add new models (R, mac) and have a very naive question. Prior to going through the steps (https://github.com/CCS-Lab/hBayesDM/wiki/How-to-add-new-model) how do I setup the /commons folder?

If I install hBayesDM from github source, I need to specify the R folder in the repository (otherwise R doesnt recognise it as a valid package). But this means that I don't get the commons folder. Can I then just manually download the /commons folder into my installation path? Ive tried adding the folder manually to a CRAN install but this doesnt work (due to missing paths)...

Any help at all would be much appreciated!

Thanks a lot!

Oli
